tools.name: explain_document
tools.description: Explains a contract, official letter, tax assessment or terms-and-conditions document in plain language, clause by clause. The document can be sent as plain text, as a base64-encoded PDF, or as base64-encoded photos of its pages — exactly one of the three. Scans and phone photos without a text layer

tools.name: get_explanation
tools.description: Fetches the result of an explain_document call that was still running. Pass the analysis_id it returned.
